Name: Daldongri Days
Author: lunarninjastudios
Description:
[size=5]Daldongri
[/size]
Welcome to Daldongri, a quiet, traditional Korean neighborhood nestled just beyond the railroad tracks.Inspired by the heartfelt, slice-of-life storytelling of K-dramas like [i]Reply 1988[/i], [b]"Daldongri: Seasons of the Heart"[/b] is a narrative-driven expansion for Stardew Valley. This mod introduces a brand-new, self-contained area, complete with its own unique music, custom crops, and a cast of eight memorable characters.In Daldongri, you are not the hero destined to save the town. You are simply a new neighbor. Through your empathy, friendship, and consistent presence over a three-year storyline, you'll help a struggling but resilient community rediscover its spirit, mend its connections, and celebrate its unique heritage.[b]Features:[/b][list]
[*][b]A New, Immersive Location:[/b] Discover the charming neighborhood of Daldongri, featuring traditional-style buildings, a gentle stream, and unique flora like Persimmon, Ginkgo, and Cherry Blossom trees.
[*][b]Eight New NPCs:[/b] Get to know the residents of Daldongri, including five new marriage candidates. Each character has a distinct personality, a detailed schedule, and a personal story arc that unfolds as you build your relationships.
[*][b]Narrative-Driven Storyline:[/b] Experience a heartfelt, three-year plot focused on community, nostalgia, and human connection. Help the town historian preserve memories, assist the local shop owner in revitalizing her business, and join in the final, heartwarming Daldongri Feast.
[*][b]Custom Content:[/b] Grow and harvest new summer crops like Perilla Leaf and Gochu Peppers. Forage for Persimmons and Bamboo Shoots. Cook over a dozen new Korean-inspired dishes and craft unique artisan goods.
[*][b]Original Music:[/b] Enjoy three new, nostalgic music tracks for the Daldongri area, diner, and general store to fully immerse you in the world.
[/list]If you're looking for an experience that adds a new layer of story, culture, and heartfelt connection to your game, we invite you to take a walk to Daldongri.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install the latest version of Content Patcher.[/url]﻿
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]How to Use[/size]
You will receive a letter once the mod is properly installed beginning your journey into the expansion.

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6.15 on Linux/macOS/Windows.
[*]Works in single player, multiplayer, and split-screen mode.
[/list]
